Scripts: Aimbot, Smooth Aim, Sticky Aim

Pro and Elite tiers include player aimbot with Target Priority, Smoothness sliders, and Prediction. Aimbot chains abilities in smooth order—staff skill rotations, bow tracking, gun finishers. Smooth Aim keeps skill aiming clean during chases without jagged misclicks. Sticky Aim locks aim at optimal cursor positions without wasting skills on out-of-range targets.

Tune delays high at first—90 to 150 milliseconds between shots—then lower them only after clean instances sessions. Instant bot bursts draw reports in Abyss replays. Deep weapon examples live in [Skill aim assist guide](/blog/aion-2-skill-script-guide/) and Abyss tuning in [aimbot for Abyss PvP](/blog/aion-2-aimbot-pvp-guide/).
Hotkey macros and clutch items

Hotkey macros fires heals, shields, or mobility items before or during aimbot engages based on enemy count radius rules you configure. Overlapping instant heals plus instant aim snaps looks robotic—add 80 to 120 ms offset so item use precedes peeks naturally. Support players bind heals on low HP; fraggers bind mobility when three enemies close distance.
Bots: Farm Assist and stack automation

Elite unlocks Farm Assist, drop respawn timers, and loadout manager—start conservative per [Elite tier guide](/blog/aion-2-elite-tier-guide/). Bots are not autopilot win buttons; they amplify farming efficiency when you already understand flight timing and zone clears. Enable farm bot only after two weeks of clean Pro script sessions.

Drop respawn timers pair with ESP wallhack drop ESP so you know when drops respawn safely. loadout manager reduces mid-game loadout swaps—Elite operators use it in high Abyss rank lobbies where tempo wins games. instance preset allows slightly more aggressive bot settings than Abyss preset.

ESP wallhack covers player ESP, drops and chests, stealth alerts, and enemy tracking on Lite and Elite—full setup in [ESP wallhack setup](/blog/aion-2-esp-wallhack-setup/). Start max ESP distance at 1200 units; expand only after a week of clean games. Drop icons use distinct colors for drop vs rare drop so sight lines stay readable.

Smoke detection with audio ping at medium sensitivity catches most hostile players without false positives on fog edge movement. Elite adds vision detector tuning for visibility radius study—pair with [radar hack](/blog/aion-2-radar-hack-guide/) for camera range plus enemy dots.
Radar Hack for supports and aim duelists

Radar hack on Lite extends camera distance beyond the default cap—supports track off-screen fights, aim duelists watch loot contests, rotators spot hostile players earlier. Dynamic zoom auto-scales when multiple enemies enter vision. Angle lock keeps tilt consistent so high zoom does not disorient during team fights.
Costume Changer and Unlock All

Elite bundles [Costume Changer](/blog/aion-2-costume-changer-guide/) with automation; standalone [Unlock All](/products/aion-2-cheats/unlock-all/) is cosmetic-only. Preview skins and appearances locally—effects are client-side on your display. Streamers enable [stream-proof mode](/blog/aion-2-stream-proof-setup/) separately for ESP overlays.
Auto Kill and Auto Interrupt

Elite finishes low-HP enemies with Auto Kill and Auto Interrupt at combo end—both respect Smoothness sliders so ranged finishers do not fire instantly on every tick. Use kill steal in instances first; Abyss preset keeps conservative HP thresholds and longer reaction delays.
